kosovo:XKX.name: Kosovo
kosovo:XKX.note: Seven statistical districts and 38 municipalities from retained GISCO 2024 and geoBoundaries 2017 references. District outlines are dissolved from the municipal mesh. Kosovo is shown separately according to its administration; its status is disputed and Serbia claims it. National statistics use the separately reported World Bank Kosovo series.
